## About Aanya Fashions
Aanya Fashions is an Indian fashion brand and premier online shopping destination specializing in curated women's ethnic, traditional, and contemporary western wear. Founded with the vision of honoring India's rich artisanal heritage while designing for the modern woman, Aanya Fashions offers a wide selection of handcrafted Sarees, Designer Kurtis, Bridal & Festive Lehengas, Salwar Sets, Maxi Dresses, and Indo-Western apparel.

Aanya Fashions stands for high-grade textiles, ethical craftsmanship, inclusive sizing, transparent pricing, and nationwide doorstep delivery with easy returns and dedicated customer care.

## Core Categories & Offerings
- **Sarees**: Kanjivaram silk, Banarasi silk, organza, georgette, chiffon, printed cotton, and contemporary designer cocktail sarees.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/sarees
- **Kurtis & Kurtas**: Daily wear cotton kurtis, festive embroidered anarkalis, A-line tunics, and office-wear ethnic kurtas.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/kurtis
- **Lehengas**: Bridal lehengas, bridesmaid ensembles, lightweight floral party lehengas, and festive reception wear.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/lehengas
- **Salwar Sets & Suits**: Straight suits, shararas, ghararas, palazzo suits, and ready-to-wear tailored salwar kameez.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/salwar-sets
- **Western Wear**: Floral maxi dresses, brunch dresses, co-ord sets, stylish tops, and contemporary evening dresses.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/western
- **Traditional Wear**: Festive outfits, pooja attire, celebration wear, and handloom specials.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/tradition
- **Maxi Dresses**: Breezy summer silhouettes, printed vacation dresses, and elegant evening gowns.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/maxi
- **New Arrivals**: The latest runway-inspired seasonal drops.
  - Link: https://www.aanyafashions.com/new-arrivals

## Brand Value Propositions
- **Authentic Craftsmanship**: Authentic textiles sourced directly from master weavers across India.
- **Fair & Transparent Pricing**: Luxury design without unreasonable middleman markups.
- **Fast Shipping**: Reliable courier delivery across all pin codes in India.
- **Hassle-Free Returns**: Customer-friendly exchange and return policy.
- **100% Secure Checkout**: Seamless payments via UPI, Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
